title: Flutter Developer

title: Android Developer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Mobile Application Developer with a strong background in mobile application development. The ideal candidate should be proficient in Java/Kotlin and Flutter, have experience working with third-party APIs, and be adept at managing local databases. The role involves integrating payment gateways, handling push notifications, and ensuring that the code is clean, optimized, and bug-free.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **App Development:** Design, build, and maintain advanced applications for the Android platform using Java/Kotlin and Flutter.
* **API Integration:** Work with third-party APIs using Retrofit to integrate external services into the app.
* **Database Management:** Implement and manage local databases to ensure efficient data storage and retrieval.
* **Payment Gateways:** Integrate and manage various payment gateways to facilitate seamless transactions within the app.
* **Push Notifications:** Implement push notification services to enhance user engagement.
* **Code Quality:** Write clean, maintainable, and optimized code that adheres to best practices.
* **Bug Fixing:** Efficiently handle error management, debug, and resolve any issues to ensure a smooth user experience.

**Skills:**

* Proficiency in Java/Kotlin and Flutter.
* Experience with third-party APIs (Retrofit).
* Hands-on experience with local databases (e.g., Floor, Room, Realm).
* Familiarity with payment gateway integration.
* Experience in implementing push notifications.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to write clean, efficient, and well-documented code.
* Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Knowledge of UI/UX design principles.
* Familiarity with version control systems like Git.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills.

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Software Development Engineer-II
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


**Introduction to the Team:**

This role is under Platform Quality team \& We are looking for high performing individual contributor who has worked prior on or willing to work on Scalable internal tools \& utilities creation for developer productivity enhancement.


Must have developed Internal or industry standard based web or native app test automation solution which is highly stable \& scalable.


**In this role, you will:**

* Design, develop, and maintain robust test automation frameworks, internal tools, and utilities that leverage AI/ML‑enabled solutions to enhance developer productivity and accelerate release cycles.
* Write clean, maintainable, and optimized code using strong knowledge of software design principles, data structures, design patterns, and computer science fundamentals across multiple tech stacks including native mobile apps, web, and APIs.
* Investigate and perform root cause analysis (RCA) of test failures and system issues, using deep understanding of the surrounding systems, logs, and monitoring to design and implement durable fixes.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve test coverage, failure detection, and feedback loops, while ensuring reliability, observability, and maintainability of these solutions in production workflows.
* Utilize and refine industry‑standard test automation frameworks, CI/CD workflows (such as GitHub Actions), and operational tooling (such as RCP/MCP servers, Datadog, Splunk) to continuously improve quality and efficiency.
* Collaborate across teams to identify and resolve inefficiencies in code, tools, and processes, driving cross‑organizational improvements, documenting major technical initiatives (including RCAs), and sharing learnings with broader groups.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
* 2\+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Professional software development or test automation engineering experience, including building and debugging applications and internal tools, with strength in at least one programming language and exposure to multiple technology implementations.
* Working knowledge of industry‑standard testing and monitoring tools for automated and distributed systems, and the ability to interpret system behavior and logs to perform effective RCA of failures.
* Ability to design and implement code and framework changes that improve stability, reliability, and test effectiveness across services or components, including familiarity with CI/CD workflows and observability tooling.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing software, automation frameworks, or internal tools in at least two programming languages (such as Java and Python), including designing and maintaining test automation systems or high‑usage internal utilities from scratch.
* Proven ability to apply design patterns for scalable, maintainable systems and frameworks, including system design (low‑level design), API design, and data modeling for test and tooling platforms.
* Demonstrated impact in selecting appropriate technologies and architectures to solve business and quality needs, connecting team goals to broader business outcomes and identifying project‑level business problems with corresponding technical solutions.
* Familiarity with AI‑driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including safely integrating and operating AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve test automation, developer workflows, or quality insights.
* Experience operating test automation and internal tooling at scale, including optimizing CI/CD pipelines, observability (Datadog, Splunk), and reliability for multi‑service or cross‑platform environments.
